name: I-DLM-32B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-32B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, uniform full attention on all 64 layers (no sliding window, no hybrid)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A distillation of Qwen/Qwen3-32B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 32.762 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-07. Caveat: the card's own claim is parity ('matches AR quality across 15 benchmarks'), and that is what the numbers show - it wins ARC-C/MATH-500/AIME-24/AIME-25 by 0.2-0.7 pp and loses MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA-D, LiveCodeBench-v6, MathBench. It qualifies on the strict rule (four same-table wins) but should be read as an architectural conversion that holds quality while gaining parallel decoding, not as an upgrade. Reproduction also requires the SGLang ISD pipeline - the card states transformers loading does not reproduce paper results.
